title: The Royal Pantiles Walking Tour
description:
Join us to see and hear how the chance discovery of a medicinal spring in 1606 by a jaded courtier on his way back to London was the start of the story of Tunbridge Wells. From nothing, it rapidly found fame amongst the great and the good (including royalty), who were attracted by the healing waters, the dancing, the shopping and the gambling. It was the out-of-town rural setting where one had to be seen. Today, the Pantiles retains its Georgian splendour as a retail and leisure destination, still blissfully cocooned from the outside world.

The meeting point at No. 4 The Pantiles (Imperial Pharmacy, Nevill Street end).

All tickets are non-refundable or transferable. Please refer to our Ticket Terms & Conditions for full details.


Enjoy 10% off food and drink at The Ragged Trousers when you present a valid tour ticket at the time of purchase.


Valid on the same day as the tour only and requires proof of a tour ticket at the time of purchase. Food served Wednesday to Sunday only.
address: The Pantiles, London Road, Tunbridge Wells, TN2 5TD

title: The Pantiles Ghost Walk
description:
Join us for an after-dark walk to hear about the unsettled souls said to inhabit the famous Pantiles in Royal Tunbridge Wells. Hear the story of a haunted hotel, a mysterious figure that appears above a restaurant and the sorrowful cries from the Common – all united in grief and loss. There will also be some insights into the oft-forgotten past of The Pantiles.

The walk will last approximately one hour and is mostly on the level, although there are some steps up and down (about 20 in total).

Your guide is David Woosnam, a qualified City of London Guide, who moved to Tunbridge Wells five years ago and has provided local walking tours for private groups and Heritage Open Days ("The Pantiles - Something In The Water", "The Elevated Decimus Burton Walking Tour" and "Station to Station - Sainsbury's to Sainsbury's").

title: The Pantiles Boutique Christmas Markets 2026
description:
Experience the Magic of Christmas at The Pantiles

This Christmas, The Pantiles will once again be transformed into one of Kent's most enchanting festive destinations. From beautifully decorated wooden chalets and live entertainment to family attractions and seasonal experiences, our Boutique Christmas Market promises an unforgettable celebration for traders and thousands of visitors alike.

Whether you're looking for the perfect Christmas gift, festive food and drink, family fun or simply a magical atmosphere, there's something for everyone.

Free Parking All Day on Friday 13th November!


In celebration of Christmas Kicking-Off at The Pantiles, we giveing all visitors FREE PARKING on Friday 13th November (only). So why not make a day of it, explore our shops, enjoy something to eat and drink, and stay with us as we switch on the Christmas Lights!

Boutique Christmas Market


Our carefully curated Boutique Christmas Market features a selection of independent retailers offering unique gifts, artisan products and festive treats from traditional wooden chalets.

Each chalet includes:

  • Traditional wooden Christmas chalet
  • Power supply
  • Interior and exterior lighting
  • Prime location within the historic Pantiles

Interested in trading with us?

We're currently accepting applications from traders selling quality gift-related products.

Register as a trader: Click Here

Download the Traders Pack: Click Here

Please note that only gift-related products will be considered.

Live Entertainment


Our iconic Bandstand will come alive throughout the festive season with a programme of entertainment, including:

  • Live musicians
  • Community choirs
  • Local theatre groups
  • Mini pantomime performances
  • Special festive performances
  • A full entertainment programme will be announced soon.

Calling All Performers!

Would you like to perform in front of thousands of festive visitors?

Email manager@pantilesevents.com to register your interest.

Christmas Lights Switch-On Friday 13th November from 5pm


Join us for one of Tunbridge Wells' favourite festive traditions as we officially illuminate The Pantiles for Christmas.

From the bandstand:


17:00 Simon P DJ Opening Set
17:30 Ben Hills sings our festive favourites
18:00 Local Choir
18:30 Meet Buttons and one of the ugly sisters in a Taster Pantomime
19:00 Lights Switch-on with some very special guests
19:05 Ben Hills takes back the mic for more festive favourites
19:30 Closing set from Simon P, bringing lots of festive vibes!

Festive Decorations


The Pantiles will sparkle throughout the season with:

  • Spectacular Christmas tree installation
  • Twinkling lights across the Bandstand
  • Festive decorations throughout the historic walkway
The perfect backdrop for Christmas shopping, dining and memorable festive photographs.

Rudolph's Runner Returns for 2026!

Back by popular demand, Rudolph's Runner returns to Tunbridge Wells this Christmas.

Delivered by RTW Together BID in association with The Pantiles, Paramount Place by Retirement Village Group and the UK Government's Shared Prosperity Fund, the festive land train will travel throughout the town, stopping at The Pantiles beside The Corn Exchange.

More details and operating dates will be announced soon.

New for 2026


The Nutcracker Trail


Discover our magnificent 5ft Nutcracker statues hidden around The Pantiles.

Collect the names of each Nutcracker to complete the trail and you'll be entered into a prize draw to win £150 in vouchers to spend in participating Pantiles shops, restaurants and bars.

It's the perfect festive family adventure.

For more details click here

Nutcracker Craft Workshop


Children (and grown-ups!) can create and decorate their very own wooden Nutcracker ornament to take home, display on their Christmas tree or feature in a festive window display.

All profits from the workshops will be donated to a local charity.

For more details click here

And There's Even More to Come...


With festive shopping, seasonal dining, live music, family attractions and magical Christmas experiences, The Pantiles Boutique Christmas Market is the perfect place to celebrate the festive season.

We look forward to welcoming you this Christmas.

title: Calverley Precinct Market
description:
Discover the buzz of Calverley Precinct Market, a lively outdoor market bringing together the very best of local produce, street food flavours and artisan crafts. Held on the last Sunday of every month, it’s a must-visit for food lovers, families and anyone who enjoys supporting local makers.

Spend your morning browsing an ever-changing mix of stalls offering fresh produce, irresistible treats, handcrafted goods and one-of-a-kind finds from talented independent traders. With seasonal themes, guest stallholders and your favourite regulars, every market has its own character and something new to discover.

Make a day of it at Calverley Precinct. Soak up the atmosphere, pick up something special, then unwind at one of the many nearby cafés, bars and restaurants, just steps away in the heart of Tunbridge Wells.
address: Calverley Precinct, Mountfield Gardens, Tunbridge Wells, TN1 1SJ
